mapper.sql: select a.id, a.notice_id, a.school_id, a.supplier_id, a.supplier_name, a.apply_no, a.apply_status, a.qualification_status, a.bid_stage_status, a.bid_result_status, a.apply_time, a.audit_time, a.audit_remark, a.apply_files_json, a.compare_files_json, a.dept_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, a.del_flag, m.title as notice_title, concat('CG-', m.id) as notice_code, d.dept_name as school_name, m.bmjz_time, m.signup_limit, m.is_samples_pic, m.samples_pic, m.notice_file, m.other_file, ( select max(n.id) from xfpt_notice n where n.ente_id = a.notice_id and n.catagory = 'CGGG' and n.type = '0' and n.status = '1' and n.del_flag = '0' ) as public_notice_id, case when a.apply_status = '2' then '已撤回' when a.qualification_status = '1' then '已通过' when a.qualification_status = '2' then '已驳回' when a.apply_status = '1' then '待审核' else '待提交' end as status_text from xfpt_supplier_apply a left join xfpt_organization_mode m on m.id = a.notice_id and m.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = m.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select m.id as notice_id, m.dept_id as school_id, m.title as notice_title, concat('CG-', m.id) as notice_code, d.dept_name as school_name, m.bmjz_time, m.signup_limit, ( select count(1) from xfpt_supplier_apply sa where sa.notice_id = m.id and sa.del_flag = '0' and sa.apply_status != '2' ) as signup_count, m.is_samples_pic, m.samples_pic, m.notice_file, m.other_file from xfpt_organization_mode m left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = m.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where m.id = #{noticeId} and m.del_flag = '0'

select m.id as notice_id, m.dept_id as school_id, m.title as notice_title, concat('CG-', m.id) as notice_code, d.dept_name as school_name, m.bmjz_time, m.signup_limit, ( select count(1) from xfpt_supplier_apply sa where sa.notice_id = m.id and sa.del_flag = '0' and sa.apply_status != '2' ) as signup_count, m.is_samples_pic, m.samples_pic, m.notice_file, m.other_file, a.id as apply_id, a.apply_status, a.qualification_status, case when a.id is null then '未报名' when a.apply_status = '2' then '已撤回' when a.qualification_status = '1' then '已通过' when a.qualification_status = '2' then '已驳回' when a.apply_status = '1' then '待审核' else '待提交' end as status_text from xfpt_organization_mode m left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = m.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' left join xfpt_supplier_apply a on a.notice_id = m.id and a.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and a.del_flag = '0' where m.del_flag = '0' and m.is_release = '1' and (m.bmjz_time is null or date(m.bmjz_time) >= curdate())
and m.title like concat('%', #{query.noticeTitle}, '%')
and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{query.schoolName}, '%')
order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc
mapper.insert:

notice_id, school_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, apply_no, apply_status, qualification_status, bid_stage_status, bid_result_status, apply_time, audit_time, audit_remark, apply_files_json, compare_files_json, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag,
#{noticeId}, #{schoolId}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{applyNo}, #{applyStatus}, #{qualificationStatus}, #{bidStageStatus}, #{bidResultStatus}, #{applyTime}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{applyFilesJson}, #{compareFilesJson}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, #{delFlag},
